description: This file implements an Android AutofillService named InlineFillService that provides inline autofill suggestions, dynamic datasets, and inline actions. It manages fill responses based on autofillable fields, handles authentication, and supports save operations, primarily serving as a component for enhancing user input experience in Android apps.

classes.name: InlineFillService
classes.description: An AutofillService implementation that supports inline suggestions, dynamic datasets, and user authentication for autofill fields.

methods.name: onFillRequest
methods.description: Handles autofill requests by creating fill responses with datasets, inline actions, and save info.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Static helper method to create a FillResponse with datasets, inline actions, dialog header, trigger IDs, and save info.

methods.name: onSaveRequest
methods.description: Handles save requests; here, it just logs and shows a message indicating saving is not supported.

methods.name: onSavedDatasetsInfoRequest
methods.description: Provides datasets info for saved datasets, cycling between three types.
